# Frozen pre-Optimal BinaryTreeLazy2 frames

This projection retains all twenty-four complete frames and qualified allocator
records from the immutable seventeen-backend clock-free campaign. Source recipes
and independently applied tuples are captured in provenance.json. The frames
are Rust observations, not predictions or C-identical entropy expectations.

Run `python3 scripts/check_reference_tree_baseline.py` to reconstruct the
projection in memory from the pinned chunk archive and verify every backend.
The checker never executes archived code, writes fixtures, or starts a child.
Exact allocation layout observations apply to the recorded target/toolchain;
other targets retain frame bytes, ownership invariants and release checks.
